acceptance: Clean exact owned per-lease host/probe payloads only after independently confirmed drain; persist pending sanitation before first write and fence durable release/recovery on unknown or orphan bytes.

implementation.sanitation: Remove only host-plan and input-probe payload environment keys from the exact frozen derivative; preserve prepared originals, other fields, logs and raw result evidence.
implementation.durability: Store exact scope/path/frozen and sanitized hashes before initial write; use a deterministic staging path. Ordinary release and recovery independently require absent staging and absent or exact sanitized final bytes. Recovery never creates directories, rewrites or deletes serialized paths.
implementation.ownership: Cleanup is a separate release proof; failed cleanup retains route/campaign control. Retain in-memory payload authority before writing, including failure after publication before control assignment.

verification.regressions: Modern/legacy host sanitation, exact scope/hash/linked-file rejection, changed derivative retained, failed acquisition after publication, independent drain denial, probe no-publication and lease retention on tamper, mixed/coordinator proof propagation, durable reload/stale-record fence, partial orphan stage without final file, missing parent read-only rejection.
verification.review: Two Sol read-only reviews clear after fixing orphan staging finding.

limitations: Source/contract tests and app build only. Crash staging residues are conservatively retained for recovery, not automatically deleted. No IntentFile codec or file transfer activated. Raw logs/results remain private retained evidence; live host readback, device closure, rendered UI and full M0-M6 remain unqualified.
